01

About

I learn by building systems I can see, test, and improve.

At Stony Brook University, I combine mechanical engineering coursework with computer science and hands-on research at the SMM Lab and MEIC Lab. I’m especially interested in projects where sensing, 3D interfaces, and physical systems come together.

My work spans haptic surgical systems, LiDAR mapping, robot communication, mixed-reality prototypes, and computer-vision experiments. Each one gives me a way to test how sensing, software, and physical systems work together.

View Work →
02

Researching how people and machines interact.

From mixed-reality robotics to haptic surgical systems, my research connects physical hardware with immersive, human-centered interfaces.
